title: InteraOne
author: Abhishek Kumbhar
body: Open-source Intercom & Zendesk alternative with AI agents

draft.why: Open-source support tool launching on PH; founders of dev-tool SaaS often become design clients, and open-source projects frequently need help with docs and onboarding UX.
options: Congrats on the launch! Curious who you're targeting first: teams self-hosting for data control, or folks mainly looking to escape Intercom pricing? The answer probably changes what your landing page should lead with.

Congrats on shipping! My guess is the AI agents are the hook and open-source is the trust signal, so I'd expect the first-run experience to show an AI-resolved conversation within minutes of signup. Is that the onboarding flow today, or does setup get in the way?

title: gitroots
author: Shawki Aladdin
body: Path-level GitHub access for developers and AI agents

draft.why: Developer tool launching on PH; founder likely technical, but the AI-agent angle is hot and a good launch comment could open a relationship if their docs/onboarding need design help.
options: Congrats on the launch! Curious about the first-time experience: when a developer connects a repo, what's the moment they see why path-level access beats a full-repo token?

Congrats on shipping! Wondering how you're positioning this: is the main buyer a dev securing their own repos, or teams building AI agents that need scoped access? Feels like those are two pretty different pitches.
